setting.help: Strip scripts and embeds of a service until its purpose is granted, and show a placeholder in place of the embed.
Record every decision together with the disclosure shown, so consent can be demonstrated as GDPR Art. 7(1) requires.
Stores a salted hash of the truncated address with each record. No readable IP is kept.
Raising this asks every visitor again. Adding a purpose, a service or a cookie already does that on its own.
Where the banner sends visitors for the full policy. Leave it empty to use the page Odoo publishes at /cookie-policy, which lists your declarations on its own.

Basic withholds Google tags until a purpose they serve is granted, so a refusal keeps them unloaded. Advanced loads them immediately and allows cookieless pings, which recovers conversion modelling but sends data before consent.
Treat a Sec-GPC request header as a refusal of everything optional. Its absence never counts as consent.
Declares in public that the signal is honoured. Only publish it once you have verified that it is.

Once a week the site fetches its own pages and lists the cookies they set, the storage keys their scripts write and the third-party hosts they load. Anything no declaration covers is put up for review.
